subject: rt-op
title: RT.OP.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in the Creative Music From the Black Aesthetic section (CMBA-4). (C)RT-OP (reality options) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality): the question is what reality-options actually look like for post-Parker black creative musicians when crossed with the social-reality of mid-century America. RT-OP outputs to SOC-RT (the crossing), SPT-GH (spiritual growth), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → TRS (transition), and PART (participation). PART carries INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) → POST (postulation), which branches to SF-RZ (self-realization) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics).
